as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="B6" value="<b>/apply-implementation-review</b><br>fix, commit; record_bundle_generation<br>always returns here for a fresh round" height="56.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="B9" value="<b>/approve-review implementation</b><br>user-only, literal confirmation;<br>apply_technical_approval — metadata-only<br>commit" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e8f5e9;strokeColor=#2e7d32;fontColor=#1b5e20;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="585.0" y="664.0" width="270.0" height="70.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="B10" value="<b>★ AWAITING_FUNCTIONAL_REVIEW</b>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff8e1;strokeColor=#ef6c00;fontColor=#bf360c;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="585.0" y="754.0" width="270.0" height="32.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="SB2" value="Outside the gates: /prepare-review (ad-hoc<br>bundle, no phase requirement) and /bootstrap-<br>workflow-v2 (drives workflow-v2-1-core only,<br>one checkpoint per invocation)." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#b0bec5;fontColor=#455a64;dashed=1;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="965.0" y="62.0" width="240.0" height="66.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="SBR" value="<b>Repaired case (salvage B8)</b><br>a plan re-approval landing IMPLEMENTING on an item whose registry is already terminal used to wedge forever. SELF_REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION has two sanctioned writers: complete_checkpoint, when the checkpoint it completes is the last one, and enter_self_reviewing_implementation, which /milestone-implement's NO_CHECKPOINT wrap-up always calls — a no-op if already there, the real transition when every checkpoint was already COMPLETE." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#b0bec5;fontColor=#455a64;dashed=1;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="965.0" y="144.0" width="240.0" height="155.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="SB1" value="<b>Bundle-generation outcomes</b><br>record_bundle_generation takes exactly two: ordinary — records a new reviewed_implementation_head and bumps implementation_revision; same_content — identical protected content, republished with both left byte-identical. Recovery is a different operation, not a third outcome: apply_implementation_provenance_recovery (/recover-implementation-provenance) supersedes a stale generation_head after a legitimate excluded-only commit. It changes neither phase nor reviewed_implementation_head, but bundle_id moves, so a fresh review is still needed." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#b0bec5;fontColor=#455a64;dashed=1;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="965.0" y="315.0" width="240.0" height="181.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="BLK" value="<b>BLOCK at implementation review</b><br>supported and durable, but not a phase transition. /apply-implementation-review pins it to the exact bundle_id (record_technical_review_block_pin) before triaging anything, then remediates exactly as for REVISE. technical_approval_gate_reachable then refuses that bundle_id whatever REVIEW_FEEDBACK.md is edited to say afterwards, so only a newly generated bundle can ever be approved." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#b0bec5;fontColor=#455a64;dashed=1;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="965.0" y="512.0" width="240.0" height="129.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="UNWR" value="<b>◇ DECLARED, NEVER WRITTEN</b><br>KNOWN_PHASES declares 17 names; only 13 are ever assigned. No work item is ever found at one of these four, and no command runs from one. SELF_REVIEWING_PLAN — /milestone-plan step 4, in session. AWAITING_TECHNICAL_APPROVAL — the implementation-approval gate's name; readiness is computed by technical_approval_gate_reachable while phase is still AWAITING_EXTERNAL_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW, and apply_technical_approval writes AWAITING_FUNCTIONAL_REVIEW directly. FIXING_FUNCTIONAL_FINDINGS — /apply-functional-review's opening line; the item stays at AWAITING_FUNCTIONAL_REVIEW unless a bounded fix republishes. AWAITING_USER_ACCEPTANCE — hard gate #6 by name; acceptance happens from AWAITING_FUNCTIONAL_REVIEW." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#7e57c2;fontColor=#4527a0;dashed=1;dashPattern=2 3;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="965.0" y="683.0" width="240.0" height="246.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="h3" value="3 · FUNCTIONAL REVIEW & ACCEPTANCE" style="text;html=1;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;align=left;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="660.0" y="796.0" width="440.0" height="20.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="B11" value="<b>/prepare-functional-review</b><br>checklist + checklist-evidence commit;<br>also performs LEGACY_READY adoption if the<br>target is that dormant item" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e3f2fd;strokeColor=#1976d2;fontColor=#0d47a1;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="585.0" y="836.0" width="270.0" height="70.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="B11R" value="<b>optional: /review-functional</b><br>report-only second opinion on checklist<br>completeness / evidence reproducibility" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e3f2fd;strokeColor=#1976d2;fontColor=#0d47a1;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="585.0" y="920.0" width="270.0" height="56.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="B12" value="You: manual testing, FUNCTIONAL_REVIEW.md only<br>if findings" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3e5f5;strokeColor=#8e24aa;fontColor=#4a148c;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="585.0" y="996.0" width="270.0" height="42.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="B13" value="<b>/apply-functional-review</b><br>classifies each finding, then routes it<br>into exactly one of three branches,<br>decided before any edit lands" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e3f2fd;strokeColor=#1976d2;fontColor=#0d47a1;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="585.0" y="1058.0" width="270.0" height="70.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="B14" value="own registry: all<br>checkpoints COMPLETE?" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fffde7;strokeColor=#f9a825;fontColor=#795548;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="585.0" y="1154.0" width="270.0" height="72.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="B15" value="<b>/accept-milestone</b><br>user-only, stage keyword “acceptance”" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e8f5e9;strokeColor=#2e7d32;fontColor=#1b5e20;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="585.0" y="1252.0" width="270.0" height="42.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="B16" value="<b>MILESTONE_COMPLETE</b>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#c8e6c9;strokeColor=#2e7d32;fontColor=#1b5e20;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="585.0" y="1314.0" width="270.0" height="32.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="BB3" value="/apply-functional-review's three branches: no<br>code change → back to the gate,<br>technical_approval untouched. bounded fix →<br>technical_approval STALE, post-fix bundle,<br>fresh implementation review. broad → a<br>remediation child work item (own governed<br>lifecycle, below)." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#b0bec5;fontColor=#455a64;dashed=1;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="965.0" y="971.0" width="240.0" height="105.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="BB4" value="No fourth path exists here. The refusal names<br>the outstanding checkpoint and exactly three<br>ways forward: finish it (/milestone-<br>implement); /apply-functional-review's<br>bounded branch; or its broad branch. There is<br>deliberately no command that records<br>acceptance of a partial round — see the<br>retired note below." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#b0bec5;fontColor=#455a64;dashed=1;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="965.0" y="1200.0" width="240.0" height="118.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="BB5" value="MILESTONE_COMPLETE is additionally<br>unreachable while any child work item names<br>this one as parent_work_item_id and is not<br>itself MILESTONE_COMPLETE (parent-completion<br>block)." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#b0bec5;fontColor=#455a64;dashed=1;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="965.0" y="1092.0" width="240.0" height="79.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="CHILD" value="<b>&lt;parent-id&gt;-remediation-&lt;n&gt;</b><br>an ordinary work item with its own registry, mapping and base_commit, created at PLANNING. /milestone-plan &lt;child-id&gt; publishes revision 1, which enters AWAITING_LOCAL_PLAN_REVIEW for a “2.1” child and AWAITING_EXTERNAL_PLAN_REVIEW for a “1” one — publish_plan_revision's ordinary version branch, not a remediation rule. It is never active_work_item_id, so every command driving it must name &lt;child-id&gt; explicitly." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#b0bec5;fontColor=#455a64;dashed=1;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="25.0" y="1020.0" width="270.0" height="129.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="LEGACY" value="LEGACY_READY (dormant, not terminal): a special one-<br>time adoption path via /prepare-functional-review —<br>not the normal product-lifecycle entry." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#b0bec5;fontColor=#455a64;dashed=1;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="25.0" y="930.0" width="270.0" height="53.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="MATRIX" value="Acceptance-matrix verification<br>(workflow_acceptance_matrix_test.py) is the release<br>gate for this tooling itself — not a lifecycle phase<br>of any work item." style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fafafa;strokeColor=#b0bec5;fontColor=#455a64;dashed=1;fontSize=9;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="25.0" y="1314.0" width="270.0" height="66.0" as="geometry"/></mxCell><mxCell id="RETIRED" value="<b>✗ HISTORICAL / RETIRED — not a live path: /accept-scoped-remediation. The documented path was unreachable under the current lifecycle (its entry state had no producer)</b><br><b>and was replaced by the bounded functional-fix + remediation-child mechanisms above. Ledger I10.</b>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffebee;strokeColor=#c62828;fontColor=#b71c1c;dashed=1;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="25.0" y="1420.0"
